name: industrial-website
description: Industrial website + PHP/MySQL CMS (blog, pages, leads, integrations)

scripts.build: npm run posts && npm run icons && npm run images && npm run assets
scripts.lint:php: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const g=require('fs').readdirSync;function w(d){for(const f of g(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+'/'+f.name;if(f.isDirectory())w(p);else if(p.endsWith('.php')&&!p.includes('/data/'))execSync('php -l '+p,{stdio:'pipe'})}}w('app');w('public');console.log('PHP syntax OK')"
